title: 12 Best Food Markets in Adelaide
description: Discover Adelaide's top 12 food markets in 2026! From the iconic Central Market to regional farmers markets, find fresh local produce, gourmet delights, and global street food experiences. Your ultimate guide to eating in Adelaide.

places.name: Adelaide Central Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh pastry from Doughnuts by Design or a delicious Bánh mì from The Market Bread Bar.

places.name: Adelaide Showground Farmers Market
places.priceRange: $15-40 AUD / $10-25 USD for a basket of goods
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked sourdough from one of the local bakeries or a jar of regional honey.

places.name: Willunga Farmers Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A coffee and a pastry while browsing, then pick up some local olive oil or fresh strawberries in season.

places.name: Plant 4 Bowden
places.priceRange: $15-25 AUD / $10-18 USD per person for a meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the wood-fired pizzas or one of the delicious vegan bowls from the various vendors.

places.name: Prospect Farmers Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly brewed coffee and a slice of homemade cake from one of the local stalls.

places.name: Gilles at the Grounds
places.priceRange: $15-25 AUD / $10-18 USD per person for a meal/drink
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample a few different food truck options – perhaps some gourmet loaded fries and a specialty burger.

places.name: Barossa Farmers Market
places.priceRange: $20-60 AUD / $14-40 USD for a full shopping trip
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked Barossa bread and a selection of local cheeses or small goods. Don't forget to try some Barossa coffee.

places.name: Stirling Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Locally roasted coffee and a fresh fruit tart from one of the pastry stalls.

places.name: Mount Pleasant Farmers Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh apples or cherries in season, and locally produced eggs or dairy.

places.name: Victor Harbor Farmers Market
places.priceRange: $15-40 AUD / $10-25 USD for a selection of goods
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly caught fish or local prawns (if available) and some regional sourdough.

places.name: Pooraka Sunday Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A huge bag of seasonal fruit or vegetables for a fraction of supermarket prices. Grab a cheap sausage sizzle.

places.name: Adelaide Night Market
places.priceRange: $10-20 AUD / $7-14 USD per person for a meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample a few different dishes from various food stalls, perhaps a bao bun, some dumplings, and a bubble tea.
